history.sg_progress: The Administration has updated the Standard Cost and Ratio Manual with the new vehicle ratio and the updated manual is expected to be completed by the end of 2024. The computing device distribution ratio of ICT assets is determined by each entity on the basis of its operational requirements. Although there is no policy as such, the standard ratio is indicatively 1:1, in accordance with the Standard Cost and Ratio Manual, and additional devices can be issued to staff on the basis of operational requirements by entities, through their annual supply chain plans for demand planning. Whereas the Global Asset Management Policy Service in the Department of Management Strategy, Policy and Compliance develops global policies on the basis of the Financial Regulations and Rules that are applicable to all entities, issues such as the rate of utilization differs at each entity and is context-specific, including conditions on the ground. Consequently, this is an issue that is better left to the operational discretion of each entity, with broad guidance from the Department of Operational Support, in conjunction with the Office of Information and Communications Technology, where applicable.

history.recommendation_text: The Board also recommends that the Administration update the vehicle holding ratio and related guidance, as well as the computing device allocation “ratio” as part of the Standard Cost Ratio Manual in order to enable the missions to improve the transparency and quality of vehicles and computing devices budget proposals in the future.
history.administration_response: The Administration requests that the Board consider the part of recommendation on vehicle ratio to be overtaken by events. The Administration revised the Standard Cost and Ratio Manual on the basis of field entities’ inputs. However, in operationalizing the revised Manual, it became apparent that accurately updating the vehicle ratios to reflect the diverse operational realities of all field entities was not feasible. Moreover, under the delegation of authority framework, field entities are better suited to determine their vehicle ratios because they possess a deeper understanding of their unique operational needs and contexts.
history.board_assessment: Given that the part of recommendation on the computing device allocation ratio has been implemented, although updating the vehicle ratios to reflect the diverse operational realities of all field entities was not feasible, the Board considers the recommendation to be overtaken by events.
